policy.narrativeTextRule: Existing authored Catholic biblical-history narrative or native Scripture only. AI may faithfully translate the exact original author text when no suitable historical translation exists; disclose translation method and record original-language witness/paragraph anchors and bilingual human editorial review. No AI-composed Bible history, abridgement, added linking/bridging prose, embellishment, invented geography, theological interpolation or silent harmonization. Keep commentary distinct from narrative. No permission requests.
